items.title: Cordis 与无特权核心
items.supports: 全部产品部件都是插件；通过共享 context 的 service、typed event 和 reversible effect 组合。
items.supportsEn: Every product component is a plugin composed through services, typed events, and reversible effects on a shared context.

items.title: Profile、Bundle 与 patch 叠层
items.supports: 运行时插件树按 bundle、profile patch、home patch、CLI overlay 的顺序组合。
items.supportsEn: The runtime plugin tree is composed in bundle, profile patch, home patch, and CLI overlay order.

items.title: Turn / Step 主流程
items.supports: turn、step、prompt、LLM、工具与 live waterfall 的关系。
items.supportsEn: The relationship among turns, steps, prompts, LLM calls, tools, and live waterfalls.

items.title: Session log 与 capability seam
items.supports: 日志是模型上下文事实源；model-visible 必须可从日志重建；seam 包含定义、提供者与消费者。
items.supportsEn: The log is the source of truth for model context; model-visible data must be reconstructable, and a seam includes definition, provider, and consumer.

items.title: Developer Preview 的兼容立场
items.supports: 首个 tag 前优先正确基础而非兼容 shim；磁盘格式没有兼容承诺。
items.supportsEn: Before the first tag, sound foundations take precedence over compatibility shims, and on-disk formats carry no compatibility promise.

items.title: 注册即 effect 与 waterfall 语义
items.supports: 贡献通过 effect/on 注册并可处置；waterfall listener 必须调用 next。
items.titleEn: Registration as effects and waterfall semantics
items.supportsEn: Contributions register through effect/on and are disposable; waterfall listeners must call next.

items.title: Model-visible 等价于 Logged
items.supports: 任何进入模型请求的输入都需要 session event，可从日志重建。
items.supportsEn: Every input entering a model request requires a session event and must be reconstructable from the log.

items.title: 显式边界与快速失败
items.supports: 跨包默认值显式 resolve，部署参数可配置，错误配置尽早失败，外部 ID 使用 branded 类型。
items.supportsEn: Cross-package defaults resolve explicitly, deployment parameters are configurable, invalid configuration fails early, and external IDs use branded types.

items.title: 静态边界和运行时边界的验证哲学
items.supports: 同进程静态类型边界信任 TypeScript；解析、模型 JSON、持久化、进程、worker 与 wire 边界做运行时验证。
items.titleEn: Validation at static and runtime boundaries
items.supportsEn: Same-process statically typed values trust TypeScript, while parsing, model JSON, persistence, processes, workers, and wire boundaries receive runtime validation.

items.title: 工具执行管线
items.supports: pre、单调 guard、around execute、post、normalization、finalize 和 immutable result 的完整顺序。
items.supportsEn: The complete order of pre hooks, monotonic guards, around execution, post hooks, normalization, finalization, and immutable results.

items.title: Agent turn/step 时序
items.supports: 输入认领、durable events、并行工具结算、停止点和 SDK 事件面的时序。
items.supportsEn: The sequence of input claims, durable events, parallel tool settlement, stop points, and SDK-facing events.

items.title: 包分组与依赖方向
items.supports: 49 个 package group 的职责、发布预期以及 extension 只依赖 service definition 的方向规则。
items.supportsEn: Responsibilities and publication expectations for 49 package groups, plus the rule that extensions depend only on service definitions.

items.title: Package 生命周期与不变量规则
items.supports: 插件导出、组合测试、owner、commit point、disposal 和每包 invariant 的约束。
items.supportsEn: Constraints for plugin exports, composition tests, ownership, commit points, disposal, and per-package invariants.

items.title: CLI 启动模式分派
items.supports: CLI 解析后仅分派 profile、plugin 与 dump-config；profile 路径传入环境快照、profile、patch 与内部参数。
items.supportsEn: After parsing, the CLI dispatches only profile, plugin, and dump-config modes; the profile path receives the environment snapshot, profile, patches, and inner arguments.

items.title: 空根配置与 Profile 准备
items.supports: 每次启动重写空根 cordis.yml，实际树完全由 patch 层构成，并避免 Loader write-back 烘焙组合结果。
items.supportsEn: Every launch rewrites an empty cordis.yml; patches define the entire real tree and prevent Loader write-back from baking in composed rows.

items.title: Profile patch 的实际组合顺序
items.supports: bundle、profile、home、CLI overlay、启动器 preset 与 telemetry overlay 的应用顺序以及行索引构建。
items.supportsEn: The application order for bundle, profile, home, CLI, launcher preset, and telemetry overlays, including construction of the row index.

items.title: 用户 patch 的在线重组
items.supports: 每代重新读取两个用户层、克隆 patch 防止引用污染，并在缺少 HMR 时挂载只监听配置的实例。
items.supportsEn: Each generation rereads both user layers, clones patches to prevent reference contamination, and mounts a config-only HMR instance when needed.

items.title: Profile 目录与内置模板
items.supports: profile 名校验、web/headless bundle 模板、默认 base bundle，以及幂等初始化的三个文件。
items.supportsEn: Profile-name validation, web/headless bundle templates, the default base bundle, and idempotent initialization of three files.

items.title: Profile 的扁平模块 fallback
items.supports: 对 dependencies 与 peerDependencies 做 BFS，从安装位置建立 profiles/node_modules 符号链接闭包。
items.supportsEn: A breadth-first traversal of dependencies and peerDependencies creates a profiles/node_modules symlink closure from installation locations.

items.title: Bundle 解析与同构组合
items.supports: 按 manifest 顺序解析 bundle 声明，缺失 dsh.bundle 时失败，并用与启动相同的 applyEntryPatches 在空根上组合。
items.supportsEn: Bundle declarations resolve in manifest order, missing dsh.bundle metadata fails, and the same applyEntryPatches operation used by boot composes over an empty root.

items.title: 事务化用户配置刷新
items.supports: HMR 精确监听用户 patch，重新生成完整 patch 列表并通过 entry.update 事务化替换；退出竞态返回空 disposer。
items.supportsEn: HMR watches the exact user patch, regenerates the full patch list, and replaces it transactionally through entry.update; shutdown races return a no-op disposer.

items.title: 事务化启动与失败清理
items.supports: host prepare 先于树挂载，Loader settle 后检查激活；任意失败先处置部分根并保留最深层错误栈。
items.supportsEn: Host preparation precedes tree mounting, activation is audited after Loader settlement, and any failure disposes the partial root while preserving the deepest error stack.

items.title: Base bundle 的 patch 与激活语义
items.supports: base 是空根上的一次 insert；后层按 id 最后写入；config 整体替换；行顺序不承载加载语义。
items.supportsEn: Base is one insert over an empty root; later layers are last-write-wins by ID, config is replaced wholesale, and row order carries no load semantics.

items.title: Base bundle 的运行时骨架
items.supports: base 直接装配 LLM、session、API、agent、jobs、retry、settings、credentials、adapter 与 JSONL persistence 等共享服务。
items.supportsEn: Base directly assembles shared LLM, session, API, agent, jobs, retry, settings, credentials, adapter, and JSONL persistence services.

items.title: Headless 产品面
items.supports: headless 不挂载 Host、HTTP、Web 或浏览器插件，只增加代码运行时、启动参数 provider 与一次性 Agent driver。
items.supportsEn: Headless mounts no Host, HTTP, Web, or browser plugins; it adds only the code runtime, launch-argument provider, and a one-shot Agent driver.

items.title: Web 的 host plane 与 agent plane 分界
items.supports: Web 禁用 base 中每 Agent 能力行，由每会话 preset 挂载；跨会话 registry 与 host API 依赖服务保留在 host plane。
items.titleEn: The Web host-plane and agent-plane boundary
items.supportsEn: Web disables per-Agent capability rows from base and mounts them through per-session presets, while cross-session registries and host-API dependencies remain in the host plane.

items.title: Bundle 与用户层顺序测试
items.supports: 测试验证 bundle manifest 顺序、后层整块配置覆盖以及无用户层的空组合。
items.supportsEn: The test verifies bundle manifest order, wholesale configuration replacement by later layers, and empty composition without a user layer.

items.title: HMR 保留最后成功配置测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖新增、应用失败、解析失败、恢复与删除，失败候选不会替换上一棵有效插件树。
items.supportsEn: The test covers addition, apply failure, parse failure, recovery, and removal; failed candidates never replace the previous valid plugin tree.

items.title: Agent 公共接口与状态语义
items.supports: 定义 provider/model/maxTokens、idle/running、session/inbox/scoped context，以及 cancel、idle、maintenance 和四种输入操作。
items.titleEn: Public Agent interface and status semantics
items.supportsEn: Defines provider/model/maxTokens, idle/running state, session/inbox/scoped context, cancellation, idle observation, maintenance, and four input operations.

items.title: 不可见 setup、commit 与 owned handle 合同
items.supports: create/resume setup 在对象未发布时构建 scoped world，可返回同步 commit；AgentHandle 是拥有 teardown 权限的 capability。
items.titleEn: Unpublished setup, commit, and owned-handle contract
items.supportsEn: Create/resume setup composes the scoped world while objects remain unpublished and may return a synchronous commit; AgentHandle is the teardown capability.

items.title: Registry 与具体 loop 之间的 factory seam
items.supports: Registry effect-scoped 注册唯一 factory，并通过调用者 context 重新 trace create/resume，使所有权跟随真正消费者。
items.titleEn: Factory seam between the registry and concrete loop
items.supportsEn: The registry effect-scopes one factory and retraces create/resume through the caller context so ownership follows the actual consumer.

items.title: AgentRegistry enter、announce 与精确 detach
items.supports: enter 验证共享身份并仲裁冲突，announce 单次发布；重入 detach 延迟到 dispatch 结束，陈旧 closure 不能删除同 ID replacement。
items.titleEn: AgentRegistry enter, announce, and exact detach
items.supportsEn: Enter verifies shared identity and arbitrates collisions, announce publishes once, reentrant detach waits for dispatch, and stale closures cannot delete a same-ID replacement.

items.title: 进程内 initiator 归因 API
items.supports: current/require/with/withoutInitiator 用 AsyncLocalStorage 传递当前 driver 的因果 Agent，但不把 ambient identity 当作授权。
items.supportsEn: current/require/with/withoutInitiator propagate the causal Agent of a driver through AsyncLocalStorage without treating ambient identity as authorization.

items.title: Initiator teardown 的 drain 语义
items.supports: 服务关闭后拒绝新 boundary，等待已返回的 Promise boundary 结算，排除启动自身卸载的嵌套链以避免自锁，最后 disable storage。
items.supportsEn: Shutdown rejects new boundaries, drains returned-Promise boundaries, excludes nested chains that initiated their own unload to avoid deadlock, and finally disables storage.

items.title: Inbox 的事件重建与 claim 顺序
items.supports: Inbox 从 seed boundary 之后的 durable splice 重建；claim 总是先取全部 next-step，再按需取一个 next-turn，并逐消息通知。
items.titleEn: Inbox event reconstruction and claim order
items.supportsEn: Inbox reconstructs durable splices after the seed boundary; a claim takes every next-step item first and optionally one next-turn item, then notifies per message.

items.title: Inbox splice 的耐久提交与身份不变量
items.supports: 先 append agent/inbox/spliced 再改 live projection；删除可标 canceled；MessageId 在两个 pending 列表上全局唯一。
items.titleEn: Durable inbox-splice commit and identity invariant
items.supportsEn: agent/inbox/spliced is appended before the live projection mutates, removals may be marked canceled, and MessageId is unique across both pending lists.

items.title: 具体 Agent 的 scope、phase 与输入映射
items.supports: ReactLoopAgent 从日志恢复 turn 与 inbox，创建 agent scope，idle/maintenance 映射为 idle，followup/steer/inject 映射到两级 inbox，cancel 默认清空。
items.titleEn: Concrete Agent scope, phase, and input mapping
items.supportsEn: ReactLoopAgent restores turns and inbox state from the log, creates an Agent scope, maps idle/maintenance to idle, routes followup/steer/inject into two inbox levels, and clears pending work on cancel by default.

items.title: Agent 准备、发布与反向 teardown
items.supports: 在资源创建前融合 caller/factory/owner 取消；发布顺序为 session enter、agent enter、session announce、agent announce、session-start；dispose 共享同一 quiescence。
items.titleEn: Agent preparation, publication, and reverse teardown
items.supportsEn: Caller, factory, and owner cancellation fuse before resources exist; publication orders session enter, agent enter, session announce, agent announce, and session-start; disposal shares one quiescence boundary.

items.title: Create、setupAndPublish 与 resume 控制流
items.supports: 新 session 与持久化 session 汇合到同一 prepare/setup/commit/publish 路径；resume load 也受 owner、caller 和 factory 取消约束。
items.titleEn: Create, setupAndPublish, and resume control flow
items.supportsEn: Fresh and persisted sessions converge on one prepare/setup/commit/publish path, while resume loading is also bounded by owner, caller, and factory cancellation.

items.title: 原子发布、并发同 ID 与 creation-only signal 测试
items.supports: 测试证明 setup 完成前两个 registry 均不可见、发布事件有序、并发准备仅一方进入，且 creation signal 不影响已返回 handle。
items.titleEn: Atomic publication, concurrent same-ID, and creation-only signal tests
items.supportsEn: Tests prove both registries stay unpublished through setup, announcements are ordered, only one concurrent preparation enters, and a creation signal cannot cancel a returned live handle.

items.title: 创建通知内重入 teardown 的顺序测试
items.supports: 测试证明通知 dispatch 中 registry 对所有 listener 保持稳定；rollback 依次卸载 scope、发布 agent/disposed，再发布 session/disposed。
items.titleEn: Reentrant teardown ordering during creation notifications
items.supportsEn: Tests prove the registry remains stable for every listener during notification; rollback then unwinds scope, emits agent/disposed, and emits session/disposed in order.

items.title: Inbox replay、替换、唯一身份与取消测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖非法持久化 splice、跨队列 replace、重复 MessageId 拒绝，以及 clear 生成两条 canceled durable splice。
items.titleEn: Inbox replay, replacement, unique identity, and cancellation tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover invalid persisted splices, replacement across queues, duplicate MessageId rejection, and clear producing two durable canceled splices.

items.title: Registry split publication 与陈旧 detach 测试
items.supports: 测试证明 enter 与 announce 分离、detach 幂等、旧 capability 不删除 replacement，以及 created listener 中 detach 延迟到全部 listener 返回。
items.supportsEn: Tests prove enter and announce are separate, detach is idempotent, stale capabilities cannot delete replacements, and detach from a created listener waits for every listener to return.

items.title: Driver containment 与 pre-step 准备
items.supports: kick 把 turn 失败和取消收敛到 driver 边界；preStep 先 claim、组装 prompt、投影动态上下文，再进入 agent/pre-step waterfall。
items.supportsEn: kick contains turn failure and cancellation at the driver boundary; preStep claims input, assembles the prompt, projects runtime context, and then enters the agent/pre-step waterfall.

items.title: Turn 状态机与结束原因
items.supports: turn/start 先于 claim；reject、空首步、step 循环、turn-stopping、异常归一化、turn/end 与连续 queued turn 的全部分支。
items.titleEn: Turn state machine and end reasons
items.supportsEn: Covers turn/start before claims, reject, empty initial steps, the step loop, turn-stopping, error normalization, turn/end, and consecutive queued turns.

items.title: Step 的模型流与工具续跑
items.supports: 每次 request 从 deriveMessages 构建，chunk 逐条落日志，成功必写 assistant/message；max-tokens、无工具、工具 concluded 与继续下一步分支明确。
items.titleEn: Step model stream and tool continuation
items.supportsEn: Each request uses deriveMessages, logs every chunk, and writes assistant/message on success; max-tokens, no-tool, concluded-tool, and continuation branches are explicit.

items.title: 可重建冻结请求的构建
items.supports: request waterfall、exact-adapter prepareCall、adapter default 标记、request/header、request/context 与最终 frozen marked request 的顺序。
items.supportsEn: Shows the request waterfall, exact-adapter prepareCall, adapter-default markers, request/header, request/context, and the final frozen marked request in order.

items.title: 动态 runtime context 投影
items.supports: 从 retained surface 恢复最近 snapshot，监听 replacement，只有内容变化时生成未提交 user message，空集合用 cleared marker 覆盖旧语义。
items.supportsEn: Restores the latest retained snapshot from the surface, follows replacements, proposes an uncommitted user message only on change, and uses a cleared marker to retire old semantics.

items.title: LLM 请求的日志重建不变量
items.supports: 对 loop-marked request 检查冻结、live session、step/header 存在，并独立对比 deriveMessages 与 folded header。
items.supportsEn: For loop-marked requests, verifies freezing, a live session, step/header presence, and independently compares deriveMessages and the folded header.

items.title: 简单 turn 与工具 round-trip 顺序测试
items.supports: 测试证明 inbox receipt 先于 turn，四个边界严格嵌套，assistant usage 持久化，工具 call/result 进入第二次派生请求。
items.supportsEn: Tests prove inbox receipt precedes the turn, four boundaries nest strictly, assistant usage is durable, and tool call/result enter the second derived request.

items.title: 空 continuation、blocked 与 pre-step 并发输入测试
items.supports: 测试覆盖 completed 后空 decision 不开新 step、reject 只留 turn 边界，以及 claim 之后注入的 steer/inject 保留到下一步或下一次 wake。
items.titleEn: Empty continuation, blocked step, and concurrent pre-step input tests
items.supportsEn: Tests cover an empty post-completion decision opening no step, rejection retaining only turn boundaries, and steer/inject arriving after a claim remaining for the next step or wake.

items.title: Request error recovery 边界测试
items.supports: 中间件失败不进入 recovery；provider failure 可在同一步多次 retry；取消优先于 retry；recovery listener 失败使 turn error。
items.supportsEn: Middleware failures bypass recovery, provider failures may retry repeatedly within one step, cancellation beats retry, and a failing recovery listener ends the turn in error.

items.title: 每次请求仅凭日志 byte-equal 重建测试
items.supports: 跨工具 step、后续 turn、prompt 与 request config 变化，测试用新 Session 从 dispatch 前事件重建 messages 和 folded header 并逐字段相等。
items.titleEn: Byte-equal request reconstruction from the log
items.supportsEn: Across tool steps, later turns, prompt changes, and request-config changes, a fresh Session rebuilds messages and folded headers from pre-dispatch events with field equality.

items.title: Abort 与 sticky max-tokens 结果测试
items.supports: 测试确认中途取消写 aborted；max-tokens 是当前 turn 内 sticky，但不泄漏到下一 turn，且截断 step 不执行 tool call。
items.titleEn: Abort and sticky max-tokens outcome tests
items.supportsEn: Tests confirm mid-stream cancellation records aborted, max-tokens is sticky within one turn but not across turns, and a truncated step does not execute tool calls.

items.title: 错误耐久化与 loop unload 测试
items.supports: 模型错误同时成为 live agent/error 与 durable turn/end error；中途卸载 owner 会停止 driver 并从 registry 移除。
items.supportsEn: A model failure becomes both live agent/error and durable turn/end error; unloading an owner mid-turn stops the driver and removes it from the registry.

items.title: Cordis 的服务、事件、waterfall 与 effect 语义
items.supports: 插件通过 service key 解耦实现，通过声明式 inject 等待依赖，通过 typed event 协作，并由可逆 effect 绑定注册与卸载。
items.titleEn: Cordis service, event, waterfall, and effect semantics
items.supportsEn: Plugins decouple implementations through service keys, wait through declarative injection, coordinate through typed events, and bind registration to teardown with reversible effects.

items.title: 所有权、提交点、边界和包级不变量规则
items.supports: 异步操作需要单一生命周期所有者；能力合同由全部消费者塑造；状态只能在提交点发布；限制必须作用于完整结果；每包拥有自己的运行时不变量。
items.titleEn: Ownership, commit-point, boundary, and package-invariant rules
items.supportsEn: Asynchronous work needs one lifecycle owner; capability contracts serve all consumers; state publishes only at commit; bounds apply to complete results; and each package owns its runtime invariants.

items.title: 作用域可见性与 effect 所有权的统一实现
items.supports: ScopedLayers 把全局贡献与作用域链叠加，最近作用域覆盖同名项；注册上下文同时决定可见性和 effect 所有权，撤销后回收空层。
items.titleEn: Unified scope visibility and effect ownership
items.supportsEn: ScopedLayers overlays global and scope-chain contributions with the nearest scope winning; the registration context determines both visibility and effect ownership, and undo reclaims empty layers.

items.title: 作用域继承、隔离和反向清理测试
items.supports: 测试验证最近 tag、同步注册、共享 quiescence、反序 teardown、按 key 路由，以及事件只向祖先作用域可见而不向后代泄漏。
items.titleEn: Scope inheritance, isolation, and reverse-teardown tests
items.supportsEn: Tests verify nearest tags, synchronous registration, shared quiescence, reverse teardown, key-based routing, and events flowing to ancestor scopes without leaking down to descendants.

items.title: 包归属的运行时不变量注册器
items.supports: 不变量按 package 选择和唯一注册，在服务自有 child fiber 中运行；失败携带 package 归属，安装失败与处置都会释放注册。
items.supportsEn: Invariants are selected and uniquely registered per package, run in service-owned child fibers, attribute failures to their package, and release registrations on failed setup or disposal.
